findings.evidence: The policy describes collecting contact information that users "give us" (name, address, phone numbers for orders), but it fails to disclose the collection of the device's address book or contact list as enabled by the 'android.permission.READ_CONTACTS' permission.
Our Websites, services and applications are designed for and directed at people 13 years of age or older. We do not knowingly collect information from children under 13.
The policy does not inform the Data Principal of the manner in which she may exercise her rights under the DPDP Act or the manner in which she may make a complaint to the Board.
